nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex Banach space, $a \in \mathbb{R}$, and $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$ locally integrable on $[0, \infty)$ with $\|f(t)\| = O(e^{a t})$ as $t \to \infty$. Then the Laplace transform $s \mapsto \int_{(0, \infty)} e^{-st} f(t)\,dt$ is complex differentiable at every point of the half-plane $\{s \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Re} s > a\}$.
nodes.title: Holomorphy of the Laplace transform under exponential growth

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex Banach space, $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$ almost everywhere strongly measurable on $(0, \infty)$, and $a, C \in \mathbb{R}$ with $C \ge 0$ such that $\|f(t)\| \le C e^{a t}$ for all $t \ge 0$. Then the Laplace transform $s \mapsto \int_{(0, \infty)} e^{-st} f(t)\,dt$ is complex differentiable at every point of the half-plane $\{s \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Re} s > a\}$.
nodes.title: Holomorphy of the Laplace transform under an exponential bound

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex normed space, $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$, $s \in \mathbb{C}$ and $v \in E$. Then $f$ has Laplace transform $v$ at $s$ when the Laplace transform of $f$ converges at $s$, that is, $t \mapsto e^{-st} f(t)$ is integrable on $(0, \infty)$, and the Bochner integral $\int_{(0, \infty)} e^{-st} f(t)\,dt$ equals $v$; as usual this integral is taken to be $0$ when $E$ is not complete.
nodes.title: Laplace transform with a given value

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex normed space, $a \in \mathbb{R}$, and $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$ locally integrable on $[0, \infty)$ with $\|f(t)\| = O(e^{a t})$ as $t \to \infty$. Then for every $s \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > a$ the Laplace transform of $f$ converges at $s$, that is, $t \mapsto e^{-st} f(t)$ is integrable on $(0, \infty)$.
nodes.title: Convergence of the Laplace transform under exponential growth

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex normed space, $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$ almost everywhere strongly measurable on $(0, \infty)$, and $a, C \in \mathbb{R}$ with $C \ge 0$ such that $\|f(t)\| \le C e^{a t}$ for all $t \ge 0$. Then for every $s \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > a$ the Laplace transform of $f$ converges at $s$, that is, $t \mapsto e^{-st} f(t)$ is integrable on $(0, \infty)$.
nodes.title: Convergence of the Laplace transform under an exponential bound

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex normed space, $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$ and $s \in \mathbb{C}$. The Laplace transform of $f$ converges at $s$ when the function $t \mapsto e^{-st} f(t)$ is integrable on $(0, \infty)$ with respect to Lebesgue measure.
nodes.title: Convergence of the Laplace transform

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex normed space, $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$ and $s \in \mathbb{C}$. The Laplace transform of $f$ at $s$ is the Bochner integral $\int_{(0, \infty)} e^{-st} f(t)\,dt \in E$.
nodes.title: The one-sided Laplace transform

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
